meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'can, am able to', paired with 'смочь'.

examples.trans: I can't today.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'стрять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get stuck'.

examples.trans: I might get stuck at the turn.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и застрять вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and to get stuck on time.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'wait', paired with 'ждать'.
